orbit_context: Synthetic near-co-orbital encounter at 550 km altitude

options.label: Hold course
options.description: Continue monitoring without committing manoeuvre budget.

options.label: Act now
options.description: Use the full six-hour warning window for a small corrective manoeuvre.

options.label: Wait: same burn
options.description: Apply the same small manoeuvre only 45 minutes before closest approach.

options.label: Wait: recover margin
options.description: Use a larger late manoeuvre to recover the same projected separation.

assumptions: All asset, debris, alert and service identifiers are fictional.
Constant relative velocity in a two-dimensional local encounter plane.
Instantaneous ideal cross-track impulse with no execution uncertainty.
The 1 km separation buffer is illustrative, not an NSpOC or operator threshold.
No covariance or collision-probability calculation is performed.
No post-manoeuvre secondary-conjunction screening is performed.
Delta-v is a manoeuvre-resource proxy, not a fuel, cost or mission-life estimate.
